en-US.description:
Trailhead plans hiking routes and keeps them available offline.

FEATURES
- Offline maps for downloaded regions
- Elevation profiles

Trailhead Pro is an auto-renewable subscription that unlocks offline regions. Terms of Use: https://example.com/terms. Privacy Policy: https://example.com/privacy.
en-US.whats_new: Offline regions: download a whole national park before you leave signal.

app_review.notes:
APP OVERVIEW
Trailhead plans hikes and keeps maps offline. Freemium; Pro subscription unlocks offline regions.

HOW TO REVIEW
1. Sign in with the demo account above.
2. Map tab > Download Region > Yosemite.
3. Pro: Settings > Upgrade. Expired-subscription account: <expired-user> / <expired-password>.

ACCOUNT DELETION
Settings > Account > Delete Account.

TESTED ON
iPhone 16 Pro (iOS 26.1).

iap.review_notes: Unlocks Map > Download Region. Use the sandbox account.
